segments.name: SaaS Commerce Platform
segments.description: Runs a cloud commerce platform that lets enterprise brands, retailers and distributors build online stores, manage orders and operate marketplaces.
segments.evidence: The CODM considers the whole Company a single operating and reportable segment, monitoring operations, making decisions on fund allocation, and evaluating performance based on a single operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay a subscription that combines a fixed fee with a transaction-based fee charged on the value of orders processed on the platform.
revenueModel.evidence: Our subscription revenue is based on a fixed subscription fee and a transaction-based fee.
